concerns.text: The plan defines the raw packing coefficient as `unit_cell_volume / sum(vdw_volume_i)` (see “Compute PC_raw” in the Compute PC_raw section), which contradicts the specification (FR‑003) and the data‑model where PC_raw is defined as `sum(vdw_volume_i) / unit_cell_volume`. This inversion changes the target variable and will invalidate all downstream modeling, evaluation, and success‑criteria calculations.
